'''Valis Lorn''' was a criminal operating in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]]. Lorn's operations covered the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Andasala/Legends|Andasala]]. Lorn's associate, [[Sires Vant]], operated as a loan shark there. Lorn also sent [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] slave [[Ughok Snorg]] to work as a henchman for one of his main agents on Andalasa.
